cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.16)
project(OtDevRecorderTests LANGUAGES CXX)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_AUTOMOC ON)
find_package(Qt5 REQUIRED COMPONENTS Widgets Test)
add_executable(recorder_test recorder_test.cpp otdevrecorder.cpp)
target_link_libraries(recorder_test PRIVATE Qt5::Widgets Qt5::Test)
if(WIN32)
    target_link_libraries(recorder_test PRIVATE user32)
endif()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME recorder COMMAND recorder_test)
set_tests_properties(recorder PROPERTIES TIMEOUT 60)
